class Point
  attr_reader :x, :y

  def initialize(x, y)
    @x = x.freeze
    @y = y.freeze
  end

  # Prevent modification of existing instances
  [:x, :y].each do |method|
    define_method("#{method}=") { raise "Cannot modify #{method}" }
  end

  def inspect
    "#<Point:0x#{object_id.to_s(16)} @x=#{@x}, @y=#{@y}>"
  end

  def ==(other)
    other.is_a?(self.class) && other.x == x && other.y == y
  end

  alias_method :eql?, :==

  def hash
    [x, y].hash
  end
end
